subtitulo: How much delivery costs, by distance from the store.

configuracao.ajuda: When enabled, the Compra Fácil checkout offers «Home delivery» in stores that are ready.
configuracao.sem_coordenadas: No location (set it in Stores & Tills)

zonas.ajuda_faixa: The range includes «from» and excludes «to». Two active zones of the same store cannot overlap. Extra time is added to the preparation time.
zonas.nenhuma: This store has no delivery zones yet.

mensagens.erro_carregar: Could not load the delivery settings.
mensagens.entrega_devolvida: Delivery returned — stock restored and sale voided.
mensagens.acerto_feito: Settlement done — the money went into the till.
mensagens.credenciais_enviadas: Courier registered. The access details were sent to {{email}}.
mensagens.credenciais_nao_enviadas: {{nome}} was registered, but the e-mail with the access details was not sent. Use “Reset password” to try again.
mensagens.senha_nao_enviada: {{nome}}’s password was reset, but the e-mail was not sent. Use “Reset password” to try again.

painel.subtitulo: What is on the road and at which stage. Refreshes by itself every 30 seconds.

atribuir.sem_elegiveis: There are no active couriers serving this order’s store. Register one under «Couriers».

entregar.referencia_ajuda: The code from the M-Pesa or e-Mola message. Used for checking later.
entregar.diferenca_a_mais: You collected {{valor}} more than expected. It is recorded.
entregar.diferenca_a_menos: You collected {{valor}} less than expected. It is recorded.

falhar.aviso: The goods go back to the store. Then, under «Return», the stock is restored and the sale is voided.

devolver.aviso: Only once the goods are back at the store. Stock returns to the warehouse, the sale is voided and the order is cancelled. This cannot be undone.

delegar.explicacao: Hands this order to an external delivery operator. They tell us about each step; the in-house courier, if there was one, loses the delivery.
delegar.tira_estafeta: {{nome}} will no longer have this delivery.

estafetas.subtitulo: Who makes the deliveries. The access code and password are generated by the system and e-mailed to the courier.
estafetas.email_ajuda: The access code and password are sent to this e-mail.
estafetas.lojas_ajuda: With none ticked, serves all stores.
estafetas.repor_confirmar: Generate a new password for {{nome}} and e-mail it? The old one stops working.
estafetas.vazio: No couriers yet. Register the first one to be able to assign deliveries.

acertos.subtitulo: The cash each courier collected at the door and has not yet handed to the store. M-Pesa and e-Mola are not included.
acertos.nada_por_acertar: No courier has cash left to settle.

dialogo.nao_bloqueia: The difference is recorded and does not stop the settlement. The till receives what was handed over.
dialogo.caixa_aviso: The money goes into your open cash session. Without an open till, the settlement is refused.

rastreio.a_aguardar: Waiting for the position of the couriers on the road. The first reading arrives within a minute.
rastreio.sem_canal: No real-time connection. Positions are not arriving; the board keeps refreshing every 30 s.
rastreio.esbatido: Faded points are over 2 minutes old: the courier may have no network or a locked screen.

webhooks.subtitulo: Automatic notices for every order and delivery, sent to the systems you choose (ERP, WhatsApp bot, delivery operator).
webhooks.vazio: No webhooks yet. Create one to receive a signed notice whenever an order or a delivery changes.
webhooks.testar_inactivo: Turn the webhook on to test it.
webhooks.apagar_texto: The webhook and its delivery history are deleted. Deliveries that were delegated to it are left without an operator.
webhooks.rodar_texto: A new secret is created and the old one stops working immediately. Whoever receives the notices must update the secret on their side, or they will no longer be able to verify the signature.

dialogo.url_ajuda: Must be https and public. Local or internal network addresses are not accepted.

segredo.aviso: Save this secret now. For security it is not shown again; if you lose it you will have to rotate it.
segredo.como_usar: Every notice carries the header X-ControlCore-Assinatura: t=<seconds>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of the text "<t>.<body>" with this secret>. Check it on your side and reject notices older than 5 minutes.
